_note: A pack that declares almost nothing. Every optional key is absent on purpose: no global seed, no world time, no player start, an event with no time of its own, a media exposure with no attention, and a `_note` key in a table that is otherwise read as data. It exists so the loader's defaults are exercised by something, which no shipped pack does -- they all fill everything in.
